<thought>Using the mass‑spectrometry data, the monoisotopic m/z of the molecular ion is 224.120115. Matching this exact mass to elemental combinations gives the formula C₁₆H₁₆O (mass = 192 + 16·1.007825 + 15.994915 = 224.120115). This formula satisfies integer double‑bond equivalents (DBE = 9). Therefore the required molecular formula is C16H16O.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H16O</final_answer>
